data.title: RAG-Based Knowledge Assistant
data.problem: Teams need accurate answers grounded in internal knowledge without sending proprietary data to external model APIs.
data.description: A proof-of-concept retrieval-augmented generation assistant that embeds documents into a vector store, retrieves the most relevant chunks for a query, and generates responses with an offline LLM. The flow keeps knowledge grounding and generation in a controlled application interface.

data.title: Library Management System
data.problem: Libraries need a reliable way to manage catalogs, members, and borrowing workflows through a modern web interface.
data.description: A full-stack application with a React.js frontend and Spring Boot backend backed by PostgreSQL. Covers core library operations such as catalog management and service APIs for client interactions.

data.title: Chat Messenger
data.problem: Users need real-time messaging supported by a scalable backend rather than a single monolithic service.
data.description: A messaging application built with Spring Boot microservices, separating concerns across services for messaging workflows, API boundaries, and maintainable backend structure.

data.title: Company Website
data.problem: The business needed a professional, responsive web presence that could be deployed and maintained efficiently.
data.description: Designed and deployed a company website using a modern React/Next.js stack with Tailwind CSS styling and Vercel hosting. Focused on clear structure, responsive layouts, and a maintainable frontend codebase.
